author: Kuber Mehta
timing: Adopted after training began, before selection-language validation selection and held-out results; not original preregistration.
observation_boundary: Only training condition names/progress and output presence inspected this turn; no selection-language training metrics, validation scores or held-out scores read for this decision. Historical WikiText, BabyLM, topology and computation results were already known.
pass_action: At most one separately declared independent-corpus confirmation with the same selection rule and fresh seeds; no subset sweep.
fail_action: After valid complete evaluation, stop anatomical subset searches in this program; publish small, null, negative and uncertain effects without claiming equivalence.
invalid_action: Preserve record and follow original recovery rules; no scientific conclusion or continuation pass.
backlog_status: Broader scaling, new subsets, SCAN, alternative language learning and physical adaptation are deferred, not an automatic next queue.
